#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runs one agent headless inside the agent container, on a sandbox copy of the repository that
# holds no holdout, no audit material, no env or scrub files and no git history. The container
# sees only that copy (mounted at /work), not the host file system. The model credential comes
# from .agent.env through --env-file and is never written into the sandbox.
# Usage: harness/sandbox.sh <agent> <target> <task> [copy-back-dir]
# If copy-back-dir is given (for example targets/<t>/clone), that folder alone is copied back.
set -euo pipefail
agent="$1"
target="$2"
task="$3"
copy_back="${4:-}"
repo="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
image="software-clone-factory-agent"
credential="$repo/.agent.env"
stamp="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
log="$repo/targets/$target/logs/$agent-$stamp.jsonl"

command -v docker >/dev/null || { echo "refusing: docker is required (OrbStack or Docker Desktop)" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -f "$credential" ] || { echo "refusing: $credential is missing (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=...)" >&2; exit 2; }
docker image inspect "$image" >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker build -q -t "$image" -f "$repo/harness/docker/Dockerfile" "$repo" >/dev/null

sandbox="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/scf-sandbox-$agent-XXXX")"
egress="scf-egress-$agent-$stamp"
trap 'docker rm -f "$egress" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$sandbox"' EXIT
"$repo/harness/make-sandbox.sh" "$repo" "$sandbox"

# An analyst may see one spent batch, and only one recorded as spent in measurements.md (its single
# look already taken). It goes under spent/<batch>/, out of every holdout path and pattern.
if [ -n "${SPENT_BATCH:-}" ]; then
  [[ "$SPENT_BATCH" =~ ^hold[a-z0-9-]*$ ]] || { echo "refusing: bad batch name $SPENT_BATCH" >&2; exit 2; }
  grep -q "\`${SPENT_BATCH}-001\`" "$repo/targets/$target/measurements.md" 2>/dev/null \
    || { echo "refusing: batch $SPENT_BATCH has no recorded look in measurements.md" >&2; exit 2; }
  spent="$sandbox/targets/$target/spent/$SPENT_BATCH"
  mkdir -p "$spent"
  find "$repo/targets/$target/fixtures/holdout" -name "${SPENT_BATCH}-[0-9]*.json" -exec cp {} "$spent/" \;
  jq --arg b "$SPENT_BATCH" '[.cases[] | select(.pass | not) | .id | select(test("^" + $b + "-[0-9]+$"))]' \
    "$repo/targets/$target/verify/holdout-verdict.json" >"$spent/failures.json"
fi

mkdir -p "$repo/targets/$target/logs"
# Hours of agent work must not vanish with the sandbox: the clone is copied back even when the run
# fails, and the run's status is returned at the end.
# Egress allowlist: the agent sits on an internal network with no route out; its only way out is
# a proxy container that lets through the model API (and the hosts a target lists in
# egress-allow.txt, such as its documentation) and refuses the rest, a code host included.
allow="api.anthropic.com"
if [ -f "$repo/targets/$target/egress-allow.txt" ]; then
  allow="$allow,$(grep -v '^#' "$repo/targets/$target/egress-allow.txt" | grep -v '^$' | paste -sd, -)"
fi
docker network inspect scf-internal >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create --internal scf-internal >/dev/null
docker run -d --rm --name "$egress" -e ALLOW="$allow" \
  -v "$repo/harness/docker/egress-proxy.mjs:/egress-proxy.mjs:ro" "$image" node /egress-proxy.mjs >/dev/null
docker network connect scf-internal "$egress"

status=0

  --env-file "$credential" -e RH_SANDBOX=1 \
  --network scf-internal \
  -e HTTPS_PROXY="http://$egress:3128" -e HTTP_PROXY="http://$egress:3128" -e NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1 \

# Recon: Stripe Billing (test mode)

Owner: main session. Step 1 of the replication playbook. Run on 2026-09-23 with
`recon/recon.sh` (raw responses in `recon/out/`, not committed: they carry account IDs).

## What was done

On a test clock frozen at `1790000000` (2026-09-21T14:13:20Z): one product with two monthly
prices (10 USD, 30 USD), a 20 % forever coupon, one customer with `pm_card_visa`, one subscription
on the 10 USD price. Then `POST /v1/invoices/create_preview` for an upgrade to 30 USD at
`proration_date = T0 + 10 days`, with and without the coupon, each run twice. Then a Customer
Portal configuration and two portal sessions (home, and the `subscription_update_confirm` deep link).

## Observed

- **Preview is deterministic except for IDs.** Diffing the two runs field by field, only `id`,
  `lines.data[].id`, `lines.data[].invoice`, `...invoice_item` and `lines.url` differ. Noise mask
  candidates: every `*_id`-like path with prefixes `upcoming_in_`, `il_tmp_`, `ii_`, `di_`.
- **Proration arithmetic, 20 of 30 days remaining:**
  - credit for unused time on the old price: `-667` (1000 × 20/30 = 666.67, rounded to 667);
  - charge for remaining time on the new price: `2000`;
  - next full period on the new price: `3000`;
  - `subtotal = total = amount_due = 4333`.
- **Coupon interaction (20 % off), a quirk worth a rule:** the remaining-time line is discounted
  inside the line (`1600`, description "avec 20.0% off"), the unused-time credit is not discounted
  (`-667`), and the next-period line is discounted at invoice level (`total_discount_amounts = 600`).
  Result: `subtotal 3933`, `total 3333`.
- **Billing mode:** new subscriptions default to `billing_mode.type = flexible` with
  `proration_discounts = included`. The docs describe `classic` as giving different totals for the
  same sequence: a parameter of the slice, not a constant.
- **Line descriptions follow the account or customer locale** (French here). Either set
  `preferred_locales` on the customer or mask descriptions: a noise source unrelated to logic.
- **Portal configuration rules, found by error messages** (awkward cases a faithful clone must reproduce):
